question: Ever hit your head really hard? 1 = yes, 2 = never
first_comment: Ever hit your head really hard? 1 = yes, 2 = never. I'll post my own answer with the reason tonight.
evening_answer_to_post_at_18_08: My answer: 1, yes, like most people. And almost no head bumps lead to a tumor. One true fact: Cushing removed Wood's meningioma in 1910 and Wood worked 17 more years, until 1927.
